audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 read 'Yorick' although whys[1] ('stays a skill matchup') and whys[2] ("it's still even") say even, and rows 3 and 4 read 'Skill' although whys[3] ('you edge ahead') and whys[4] ('you keep the pre-Maiden lead') say Urgot. Packet levelChart: Skill, Skill, Skill, Urgot, Urgot, Yorick, Yorick.
audit.why: At 49.89% this is a genuinely even lane whose shape is: no favourite until 4, a short pre-Maiden Urgot window, then Yorick from Eulogy of the Isles onward. The chart was describing a different lane from the text beside it.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 set to Skill, rows 3 and 4 set to Urgot with ratings raised from 4/10 to 6/10, in both layers. phases[1].why and phases[2].why rewritten so they stop claiming Urgot owns those stages.

audit.why: Spikes are well-placed and specific: Urgot's window is 3-5 before the Maiden, Yorick's is level 6 Eulogy of the Isles and every item stage after. Only the chart contradicted it.
audit.corrected: Spike text unchanged; dontsFull[1].d now carries the 160s rank-1 R cooldown that defines the window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites heals Yorick on every empowered attack and is an auto-attack reset — neither is stated anywhere on the page, so there is no anti-heal call and no commit tell. dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d were generic filler, and nothing mentions that Dark Procession's walls are destructible.
audit.why: Riot's own text calls Dark Procession 'a destructible wall', which changes the entire response to being caged — you break a wall instead of standing in the ghoul ball. It is a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown. Last Rites is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s with heal and autoReset flags, so extended trades feed him and the wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now gives the 20s cage cooldown and its destructibility; dontsFull[0].d tells the player to break a wall; dontsFull[1].d carries the 160s Maiden cooldown; wants.you[1] now calls for Grievous Wounds against Last Rites.
